facts.fact: 开篇：Nikolas 对镜如逢陌生人——空眼窝的红肉、金短睫；医师建议玻璃义眼（lifeless blue iris），「most patients fare better with one」，他选了眼罩。
facts.anchor: Nikolas Cyr stared at his reflection, and a stranger stared back.

facts.fact: 失目已数月：只敢半心半意地瞥、麻木打量；义眼躺在梳妆台上瞪着天花板，旁边是盐水碗与眼罩。
facts.anchor: It was the same face he had seen for months, either in half-hearted glimpses or numb observance.

facts.fact: 数周前 Angelica 就说过「我们时间不够了」——与他诸神夜前父亲拽他起床看垂死太阳时的念头同句；众人怪天冷反常，他知道是太阳在减光。
facts.anchor: We’re running out of time, Angelica had said weeks ago.

facts.fact: 仆人 Isobel 报信：代理高级专员与 first comandante 又来函谈兵力重划——公文在「Lord——in your office」（称呼滑舌，父位已空）。
facts.anchor: Sorry to disturb you, my lord,

facts.fact: 阳光房：母亲 Madeia 与 Vaega 流亡王子 Fin 织毛衣——Fin 宫殿没了、父亲死了、封号受损、无人知其存在；Madeia 多日来第一次笑。
Rian 两天未眠、药已失效（nauseous 但 not working anymore），主动提出想恢复操练；Nikolas 提议一起练——「they had no one left to teach them」。
facts.anchor: I haven’t slept in two days.

facts.fact: 忏悔回放：Rian 病情稳定后 Nikolas 跪在床边自白——父亲眼中悲伤的疯狂、诸神夜的天台、求生的孤注一掷；Rian 手指轻碰他的手：「Don't say any more.」
facts.anchor: and a rooftop on Godsnight, and the desperate urge to survive.

facts.fact: 递矛被拒：Nikolas 以「temporary keeper」双手奉矛、称父亲训练的是 Rian；Rian 暴起掷矛砸碎红陶花瓶（碎片如血溅鹅卵石）——「I don't want the fucking spear!」
facts.anchor: Father trained you to be heir. Not me.

facts.fact: 章末：Nikolas 呕出一根白羽——雪白泛最淡的金，羽枝湿竖——神从未离开他的身体。
facts.anchor: A feather, white as alabaster, with the faintest hint of gold.
